text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I did it! I got first place!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting closer—another step forward
in
perfecting the winning equation!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting closer—another step forward
in
perfecting the winning equation!
choice_data_list: It's 'still' just one step, you know.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Really, though, I should also be

congratulating you.
choice_data_list: It's 'still' just one step, you know.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This victory belongs to the both of us.
We're
chasing this dream together!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I plan to prove the superiority of my
logical
approach in the next race too!
After which...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We'll celebrate our victory together
once more!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I suppose I mustn't get carried
away.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Pride comes before the fall, as they say.
One
should always take stock of what
mistakes were
made and learn for the
next time around.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
On that note... Were there any errors
with my
opening... or my last spurt? I
feel like I could
spend all day combing
through my performance.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Perfect! And thank you for making sure I
don't
rest on my laurels.
choice_data_list: Let's do a review right away.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to have you in my corner.
